name: caramos-landing
description: Bilingual Vite + React landing page for CaramOS.

scripts.build: yarn sync:installer && vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.jsx --outDir dist-ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.dev:api: yarn build && npx wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788
scripts.deploy: yarn build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name caramos-landing
scripts.stats:active: npx wrangler d1 execute caramos-dong-hanh --remote --command "SELECT day, COUNT(*) AS machines, SUM(edition = 'cinnamon') AS cinnamon, SUM(edition = 'xfce') AS xfce FROM active_machines GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 30"
